Verdict: no buy. The case for demand lasting 30-60 more minutes is not established, and the 30-115 minute base rate for ORGANIC-to-dip entries is negative. Skip.
memos.skeptic:
The most likely loss here is a dump after a parabolic run. The coin returned about 880% over 30 minutes and is now 36% off its high, with the last 15 minutes showing net flow of just +62 SOL against 3,844 SOL sold, a sell-to-buy ratio near 1 and 4,310 sellers versus 5,297 buyers. That is distribution by early holders into retail demand, and a $20 entry pays 1.4-5.1% round-trip costs on top of any move.

The first two minutes after graduation are a warning: 398 SOL bought, a 0.98 sell-to-buy ratio, and a launch bot present. A bundle share of 0.39 suggests coordinated early buying that has since unwound. The name "The Day Trader" and symbol "Aiden" are cosmetic and carry no signal either way.

Base rates for a random buy in this window have lost about 20%, and a dip in a coin that has already fallen this far rarely recovers. Skip.
